mapper.insert: INSERT INTO members (email, nickname, password_hash, role, status) VALUES (#{username}, #{name}, #{password}, 'USER', 'ACTIVE')
mapper.select: SELECT email AS username, nickname AS name, password_hash AS password, 0 AS cash, email AS email FROM members WHERE email = #{username}

SELECT m.email AS "USERNAME", m.nickname AS "NAME", m.password_hash AS "PASSWORD", 0 AS "CASH", m.email AS "EMAIL", CASE WHEN m.role = 'ADMIN' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END AS "ROLE_NO", m.role AS "ROLE_NAME" FROM members m WHERE m.email = #{username}
